## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D open-world Korean woman police patrol game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Include Seoul-inspired streets and beach, civilians and criminals, patrol missions and random events, infinite money, police equipment, emotional and shoe-wear systems, and a shop with 30+ shoes, tights, and a white shirt.
- Support street and beach patrol; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- The officer is a fictional adult with a stylish, non-sexualized design.
- Suspect encounters use safe arrests and reporting instead of firearm-based combat.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the Three.js/Vite game with city and beach scenes, officer and NPCs, missions, random events, HUD/minimap, shop, emotional and shoe systems, and keyboard/touch controls.
- Relocated the boutique canopy/sign, added a visible canvas-text sign, and aligned the shop marker and interaction location at `(15, 22)`.
- `npm run build` succeeds; Chromium headless captured `/tmp/opencode/seoul-patrol.png`.

### Active
- Validate the browser-rendered game visually and test gameplay interactions and runtime errors.

### Blocked
- Browser screenshot was captured, but its image was not inspected in the conversation; no movement, shop, mission, or arrest interaction test was performed.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/seoul-patrol.png` and assess the game’s rendered appearance.
2. Test movement, boutique interaction/catalog, missions, and safe arrest in-browser; check for runtime errors.
3. Fix issues found and rerun `npm run build`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Gameplay, controls, missions, shop, interactions, and HUD.
- `src/world.js`: Scene construction, boutique sign, markers, and characters.
- `src/style.css`: HUD, modal, and responsive styling.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `/tmp/opencode/seoul-patrol.png`: Headless Chromium screenshot for visual review.

- Changes are uncommitted; project files appear untracked in `git status`.
- Shop has 36 shoe items and 8 tights.
